photography.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: exterior photograph used on the DXTRL corporate website. Image 1 is the edit target. Edit this existing car dealership photograph into a brand-neutral dealership exterior. Remove BOTH prominent Honda H emblems and the red HONDA text on the two upper building facades, including their sign mounting panels, and naturally reconstruct the continuous silver-gray vertical facade cladding. Remove every other Honda logo, name, branded roadside or distant sign, and identifiable dealership/brand lettering or emblems anywhere in the photo, including at the far left and on the parked cars or windows. Replace the vivid red support columns with neutral charcoal-gray columns so the dealership no longer has identifiable Honda color branding. Keep the real photographic appearance, original wide 2:1 composition, perspective, building geometry, glass showroom, parked vehicles, hedges, pavement, clear blue sky and daylight as close to the original as possible. Make vehicle badges and license plates plain and unreadable; do not invent a replacement brand or add text. Seamless natural architectural retouching, no blur patches, no watermarks, no logos, no recognizable automotive branding. Output a wide landscape image in the same 2:1 aspect ratio.

photography.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a landscape 16:9 photographic website asset for Dealer AX, a Japanese dealership AI implementation service by DXTRL. Contemporary modest regional Japanese car dealership, warm daylight, neutral beige and dark forest green accents. Realistic Japanese adult people, natural candid expressions. No logos, no car badges, no brand signage, no readable customer data or numbers, no text overlay, no watermark. Computers and documents show indistinct non-readable material. Generate one complete scene filling the landscape frame. Scene: car sales consultation at a real Japanese local car dealership showroom. A Japanese female sales advisor in her 30s wearing a simple dark green blazer at a wood table with two Japanese adult customers in their 40s, relaxed sincere conversation over a tablet and a few papers. An unbranded white SUV is visible through the room at a natural distance, green trees through floor-to-ceiling windows. Eye level 35mm documentary photograph. The focus is attentive service and genuine communication, not posed smiles or handshakes.
